### Friends

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.methods.friend`  
**Type:** class  
**Hierarchy:** java.lang.Object → org.dreambot.api.methods.friend.Friends → org.dreambot.api.methods.friend.Friends  

**Methods:**
```java
static boolean addFriend(String playerName);
static boolean addFriend(Player player);
static List<Friend> all();
static boolean deleteFriend(String playerName);
static boolean deleteFriend(Friend friend);
static Friend get(String playerName);
static int getSize();
static boolean haveFriend(String playerName);
static boolean isFriendsSelected();
static boolean sendMessage(String playerName, String message);
static boolean swapToFriends();
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `addFriend(String playerName)` | Adds a given name to your friend's list |
| `addFriend(Player player)` | Adds a Player to your friend's list See addFriend(String) |
| `all()` | Gets a list of your friends |
| `deleteFriend(String playerName)` | Removes a player from your friends list based on player name |
| `deleteFriend(Friend friend)` | Removes a Friend from your friends list |
| `get(String playerName)` | Gets a Friend in your friend list based on player name Auto formats all names checked Looks for both current and previous names of the Friend |
| `getSize()` | Gets the size of your friends list |
| `haveFriend(String playerName)` | Checks if a player's name is inside of your friends list Auto formats non-alphabetical/numerical characters to spaces Checks both current and previous names on the Friend |
| `isFriendsSelected()` | Checks whether Friends tab type is selected instead of Ignored |
| `sendMessage(String playerName, String message)` | Sends a message to a friend |
| `swapToFriends()` | Swaps to the friend specific tab instead of the ignored tab |

### HintArrow

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.methods.hint`  
**Type:** class  
**Hierarchy:** java.lang.Object → org.dreambot.api.methods.hint.HintArrow → org.dreambot.api.methods.hint.HintArrow  

**Methods:**
```java
static boolean exists();
static int getHeight();
static int getNpcIndex();
static int getPlayerIndex();
static Character getPointed();
static Tile getTile();
static HintArrowType getType();
static int getTypeValue();
static int getX();
static int getY();
String toString();
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `getHeight()` | Gets the height of the hint arrow Gamepack usage is height*2 when grabbing field, so this field automatically adjusts to *2 If you want the true base value, divide this value by 2 |
| `getTile()` | If there is a character being pointed at, it will return the Character's Tile Otherwise if the type of hint is a Tile, it will return the arrow's Tile from x/y + your player's Z Otherwise it will return null |
